narrative_function: Kamala Blomberg-Konadu is a pressure point â€” the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When they make a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of their stories.

daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure â€” wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

2. Reposition â€” move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten â€” make consequences clear without committing to them

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm â€” it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking â€” Morse code for a word they won't say
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves

breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend: Sub-Saharan African (41.8%), South Asian (17.8%), Hispanic/Latin American (17.7%), Eastern European (10.2%), East Asian (7.9%), North African (4.6%). Features reflect this intricate ancestry â€” warm deep brown skin with golden and olive undertones creating luminous depth. Facial structure combines high cheekbones and angular jaw from South Asian and Eastern European heritage, broadened by Sub-Saharan African bone geometry. Eye shape carries subtle epicanthal folds from East Asian ancestry, rounded by the broader eye set of African heritage. Overall appearance is distinctly multicontinental: neither fully any single ancestry, but a harmonious synthesis of multiple genetic traditions.
physical_description.build: Lean and muscular with functional density â€” no wasted mass. Shoulders and forearms show defined musculature from repetitive strain and deliberate conditioning. Core is tight. They move like someone who has trained their body as a tool.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with bleached platinum undercut

physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden and subtle olive undertones â€” luminous depth reflecting the blend of Sub-Saharan African base with South Asian warmth and slight Eastern European and North African cooling. Skin appears to shift between warm gold and subtle olive depending on light angle.
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones and angular jaw reflect South Asian and Eastern European structure, enhanced by Sub-Saharan African bone geometry creating a distinctive facial architecture. Skin is clear but marked by old chemical burns on the right temple (faded to white scar tissue) and burn scarring on right cheekbone. Expression is typically neutral â€” learned impassivity. Skin condition is deliberately maintained despite occupational wear.

distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar along right temple where neural dampener was installed â€” thin, precise, healed white

physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural dampener visible as a slight bulge and faint silver-chrome threading at the right temple, visible especially when light hits the scar tissue. The implant creates a subtle shimmer under skin. Hydraulic joints in both knees and elbows are partially visible â€” dark chromed plating at the elbow joints, visible through thin clothing or when moving. A faint hydraulic hiss is audible when they bend quickly.

When at rest, their gaze is always measuring: distance, angles, structural integrity of their surroundings. They walk with a slight forward lean, as if perpetually ready to move. Hand movements are controlled and deliberate.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional wear â€” reinforced tactical pants in dark gray with visible tool loops and cargo pockets, usually carrying detonators or inspection equipment. Sleeveless or short-sleeved shirts to display augmented joints as a form of transparent credibility. Worn leather or synthetic jacket in black, covered in small heat-scorch marks and chemical stains from work. No corporate logos or branding â€” deliberately anonymous. Minimal jewelry except for a thin duralloy bracelet on left wrist (no visible function, possibly personal).
